how_to_get_started_process.name: Select Your Business Application
how_to_get_started_process.action: Browse the Cael Hub application directory (Ride-Hailing, Trucking, Massage & Wellness, Child Protection, etc.) and choose the business model that fits your goals.

how_to_get_started_process.name: Submit an Inquiry via Contact Terminal
how_to_get_started_process.action: Reach out using the on-page Contact Us transmission terminal or email caelhub@gmail.com with your business name, target city or region, and application choice.

how_to_get_started_process.name: Brand Personalization & Partnership Alignment
how_to_get_started_process.action: Provide your official company logo, brand name, color preferences, and operational parameters under the simple 2% service-share agreement.

how_to_get_started_process.name: Managed Technical Setup & Google Play Store Publishing
how_to_get_started_process.action: Cael Hub configures your cloud backend, provisions database instances, compiles your branded mobile application, and handles Google Play Store publishing.

how_to_get_started_process.name: Launch, Operate & Scale Your Business
how_to_get_started_process.action: Onboard your drivers, therapists, staff, and customers. Operate your business and collect revenue while Cael Hub keeps the software and infrastructure running 24/7.

faq_knowledge.question: Do I own the source code of the application?
faq_knowledge.answer: No. Cael Hub operates on a managed technology partnership model. You own 100% of your business brand, your company name, your customer relationships, your revenue, and your operations. Cael Hub retains and maintains the underlying software codebase, servers, and infrastructure so you never have to worry about technical debt, hosting bills, or hiring expensive software developers.

faq_knowledge.question: Are there any hidden costs or setup fees?
faq_knowledge.answer: Zero hidden costs. There are no upfront setup fees, no monthly server licensing bills, and no maintenance retainers. Cael Hub is sustained through an agreed, automatic 2% share of your business's collected service fees on eligible transactions.

faq_knowledge.question: Can I use my own logo and brand colors?
faq_knowledge.answer: Yes, absolutely. Every application is personalized with your official company name, custom logo, corporate color theme, and app icons. To your customers, it is entirely your company's mobile application.

faq_knowledge.question: Who manages the day-to-day business operations?
faq_knowledge.answer: You and your team manage operations, rider/driver onboarding, marketing, pricing strategy, and local customer service. Cael Hub manages the software, cloud servers, databases, bug fixes, and Google Play Store maintenance.

faq_knowledge.question: What does CAEL stand for?
faq_knowledge.answer: CAEL stands for 'Come And Earn Literally'. It represents the mission to turn entrepreneurship dreams into tangible, earning businesses through accessible, managed technology.
